questions.question: Which type of dementia has a sudden (stepwise) onset?
questions.explanation: Vascular dementia progresses stepwise after successive infarcts.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Which type of dementia affects men more than women?
questions.explanation: Vascular risk factors are commoner in men, so multi-infarct dementia is more frequent in males.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Sundowning syndrome means:

options.A: Decreased concentration and calmness in the afternoon
options.B: Increased confusion and agitation seen in the late afternoon

questions.explanation: Patients with dementia worsen at dusk.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Symptoms of depression should last at least ______ to be classified and diagnosed as depression.
questions.explanation: DSM criteria require depressive symptoms for at least two weeks.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: In ______, the fear of illness is excessive or beyond proportion to the actual illness.
questions.explanation: Hypochondriasis involves persistent fear of having a serious disease.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
